description.value: Royal Zayka is a sit-down Indian restaurant on Vedder Road in Chilliwack, serving authentic subcontinental cuisine with spice levels ranging from mild to 'atomic hot' so diners can tailor their meal. The restaurant draws on Ayurvedic culinary philosophy, highlighting traditional spices and copper-vessel water as part of its food culture. OSM records outdoor seating, and the restaurant offers online ordering and a dedicated takeout menu alongside full dine-in service.
